notes_for_editor: Only one source: the FFLA Colorado list. The list places the entry under Unknown/Undocumented Sites and says any such site moves to the lookout lists if evidence shows regular fire-lookout use, so this may not be a fire lookout at all. A web search for the coordinates found no other source describing a lookout here. The nearest documented lookout on the list is Hahns Peak, about 30 km away; it is a separate site and is not used here. The brief name Unnamed lookout is the FFLA name unnamed with a capital U added. Because the story has almost no content, the editor may decide whether this record belongs in the lookout set at all. Blast radius: none beyond this record.
